sentences.zh: 就是没有全部整合在一起。

sentences.en: Like with the virtual keyboard, they can do all this, you know, oh, you pressed here, but you really meant to press here.

sentences.en: Um, well, that, that, that's been the black, that's been blackberry's market.

sentences.en: So like, you know, wherever, but, uh, everything that could be was in Canada.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，不管在哪，但是，呃，所有能放在加拿大的都在加拿大。

sentences.en: Anyhow.

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: and still is, you know, is there up with Android or was it inevitable that if they stuck with

sentences.en: Um, blackberry could have been the, the, like one of the top Android phones.

sentences.en: Um, blackberry was going to go to Android early days of Android before, before it was like just kind of decided, like before Samsung took over, you know, and things like that.

sentences.en: Um, but the, um, Google versus Oracle Java, uh, uh, lawsuit was going on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是，谷歌对阵甲骨文Java的，呃，呃，诉讼正在进行中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 嗯，所以黑莓当时的想法是，咱们别蹚这浑水。

sentences.en: You know, we've got, we were on good relationship with Oracle and we're, you know, and all the
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们和甲骨文保持着良好的关系，而且我们，你知道，和所有

sentences.en: in sun and all the business side, we don't want to, we don't want to mess up with that.
sentences.zh: Sun以及商业方面的人都有合作，我们不想，我们不想把事情搞砸。

sentences.en: And, and, you know, we don't, we don't want it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们不，我们不需要。

sentences.zh: 我们现在不能转到Android，因为这其中有巨大的问号，那就是Android能否在这场诉讼中存活下来。

sentences.en: So instead they went to Q and X, um, and made their own OS, which was cool.
sentences.zh: 所以他们转而采用了QNX，嗯，制作了自己的操作系统，这挺酷的。

sentences.en: Um, like blackberry 10 was, uh, was, and the funny part is this is actually how I started on the C plus plus committee.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像黑莓10是，是，有趣的是，这也是我最初加入C++委员会的原因。

sentences.en: Um, blackberry 10 was the only phone OS where the, where the, you know, premier language for writing applications was C plus plus, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，黑莓10是唯一的这样一个手机操作系统：其编写应用程序的首选语言是C++，对吧？

sentences.en: If you're on, if you're on iPhone, it used to be, um, objective C and now it's Swift.
sentences.zh: 如果你在，如果你在使用iPhone，过去是，嗯，Objective-C，现在是Swift。

sentences.zh: 如果你在使用Android，那是Java。

sentences.en: It was the C plus plus phone, right?

sentences.en: And everything was like native C plus plus.

sentences.zh: 嗯，这也是我加入委员会的原因之一，因为我其实说，我是说，我已经参与其中了，但我当时已经在参加Boost会议和C++大会了。

sentences.en: And, and people like Beeman, um, Dawes wanted me, like I met him at boost and he's like,
sentences.zh: 而且，像比曼，嗯，多斯希望我，我在Boost会议上遇到了他，他说，

sentences.zh: 嘿，加入委员会吧。

sentences.en: He's one of the reasons he's awesome guy.
sentences.zh: 他是原因之一，他是个了不起的人。

sentences.en: Um, he's one of the reasons I got onto the committee, but I also, I was at blackberry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是让我进入委员会的原因之一，但同时，我也在黑莓工作。

sentences.en: And I said, Hey, you know, you're the, you're the only phone that is relying on C plus plus.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，嘿，你知道的，你们是，你们是唯一一家依赖C++的手机厂商。

sentences.zh: 而且你知道谁在委员会里吗？微软、苹果，还有，呃，谷歌，对吧？

sentences.zh: 他们，他们控制着你为手机选择的语言。

sentences.zh: 你的前三大竞争对手，你知道的，正在掌管你所使用的语言。

sentences.en: So you should have somebody on the committee to, to, you know, speak for blackberry.
sentences.zh: 所以你应该在委员会里安插一个人，来，你知道的，为黑莓发声。

sentences.en: And it's actually funny because I wrote this long email saying like all these, that, and a bunch of other reasons why blackberry should have someone on the committee.

sentences.en: And then at the very end, it's like, by the way, that person should be me.
sentences.zh: 然后在最后，我说：顺便说一句，那个人应该是我。
